summary.text: Steve Padilla was elected to the California Senate in November 2022 and represents the 18th District, representing the counties of San Diego, Imperial, Riverside and San Bernardino.

paragraphs.text: He served 13 years in law enforcement, was elected to the Chula Vista City Council in 1994 and served two terms, and was Mayor of Chula Vista from 2002 to 2006.
Padilla was appointed to the California Coastal Commission, where he was Chairman from 2019 to 2021, and is a lifelong Chula Vista resident.
